reason: Maker/retailers rate nominal impedance 4 ohm (compatible with 4, 6, 8 ohm amps); fails the 6/8 ohm rule. On-wall, 25.3x6.4x1.83 in with bracket, 94 dB claimed.
brand_notes: MartinLogan current on-wall line (Motion SLM, SLM XL, SLM X3 bar) is rated 4 ohm; martinlogan.com product URLs for the SLM family returned 404 so confirmed via Audio Advisor and Abt.
